entities.summary: Oda Nobunaga, a notable figure in the history of Japan, associated with Muromachi and Sengoku Periods (1467–1573). Preceded by Ōnin War devastates Kyoto and begins the Sengoku 'Warring States' period and Ashikaga Yoshimitsu builds the Golden Pavilion (Kinkaku-ji) in Kyoto. Their legacy influenced Portuguese arrive at Tanegashima — firearms introduced to Japan and Battle of Nagashino — Nobunaga's massed firearms defeat Takeda cavalry.
